extracted.intended_audience: people attempting to create a new Wikipedia article (new or existing Wikipedia editors)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for producing a new Wikipedia page: prerequisites for creating pages, alternatives (drafts, requests), and troubleshooting steps when a title is not visible or has been deleted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmed requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you are not logged in or autoconfirmed you cannot create the page directly; consider other options such as using the article wizard or requesting a new article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard / submit a draft for review
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The article wizard helps authors prepare and submit drafts for review if they cannot or should not create a live article immediately.

rubrics_metrics.name: Request a new article
rubrics_metrics.description: You may request a new article instead of creating it yourself.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the 'request a new article' process if you are unable to create the article directly or prefer someone else to create it.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search existing articles for alternative titles or spellings
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for the page title in existing articles to check for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a new page, search Wikipedia to avoid duplication and to find possible existing coverage under different spellings or titles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check pages that link to the title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examining incoming links can reveal whether the topic is already covered elsewhere or whether a redirect would be appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Database update delay / page visibility
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the page was just created, wait a few minutes or try the 'purge' function to force an update.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title case-sensitivity and redirects
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If your chosen title doesn't appear, test different capitalizations and create or request a redirect if appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: If the page has been deleted, consult the deletion log
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log and see 'Why was the page I created deleted?'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the deletion log to understand deletion reasons and to guide any future attempts to recreate or draft the article to address those issues.
